title: 025 - Enough Items
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print enough when the list contains 3 items and prints exactly `enough`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def enough_items(values):
    return ",".join(str(value) for value in sorted(values, reverse=False))
solutionCode:
def enough_items(values):
    return ",".join(str(value) for value in sorted(values, reverse=True))
hint: A count of exactly 3 should pass.
explanation: The comparison is too strict. Using an inclusive length check fixes the label.
